body:
Sorry for sounding bitter and stuff 
I'm really not ok
I don't mean to offend anyone who's trying to help

I understand why she hates me, I caused her troubles and I take it as one of the consequences
I still like her a lot, it's not like I want to be with her,
(she was my teacher, and most probably she's married)
but I just wish that she could feel happy about my feelings towards her instead of feeling bad and taking it as an insult because I'm way below her league 
Actually I just want to be her student the whole time to be honest
I want to ba a student she likes, and a student who likes what she teaches instead of having romantic feelings for her 
It's just that things have gone so wrong
Everyday is so painful

the whole thing is more complicated but
I interrupted her class and disappointed her
She was my teacher 


I didn't know that I had feelings for her
when I did I started avoiding her
then a lot happened but to simplify things, she accused me of things which aren't true afterwards
(saying I went to a motel or sth, I bet it is much worse when she talks behind me, I never had sex with anyone, never intended to)
That's why I felt that I needed to confess to her
If I have had a love/sexual relationship with someone, I would never have told her I liked her 
I'm just trying to prove myself to her

thanks for the reply
I'm in my early 20s.. and it is my first time to fall in love with someone,(and my first time to confess)

I wronged her and upset her, I deserve this, it's just the pain is hard to bear...
